_doc: 图标清单：每个 id 出什么题、用哪种幕布。规则（风格提示词 / 分组 / 尺寸 / 流程）在 docs/icons.md。

variants.prefix: 16-bit pixel art inventory sprite of a single object for a medieval fantasy city-building game, hand pixel-shaded with visible square pixels, one-pixel dark warm-brown outline, four tones of flat colour with subtle dithering, muted natural palette,

variants.note: 手绘 cozy 像素（偏 Stardew）
variants.prefix: Hand-painted pixel art item icon from a cosy medieval town simulation game, 64x64 sprite enlarged with nearest neighbour, soft dark-brown outline, rich dithered shading with small specular highlights, slightly desaturated warm palette,

Detailed isometric pixel art game icon, three-quarter top-down view, 64x64 sprite upscaled with hard pixel edges, thin dark outline, light from the upper left, dithered highlights, muted earthy fantasy palette,

variants.note: **纯色抽象家族纹章**（B4 势力徽记用这个）：平涂、无明暗、无渐变、粗描边
variants.prefix: Flat heraldic coat of arms of a noble medieval house, a single heater shield with simple abstract charges, only solid flat colour fills, four or five tinctures at most, no shading, no highlights, no gradients, no dithering, no bevel, no texture, thick uniform dark outline, bold minimal shapes that read at tiny size, medieval European heraldry, one-pixel pixel-art edges,
variants.suffix: No text, no letters, no banner, no ground shadow, no glow, no vignette, no gradients, no background texture, no watermark, no second object; the shield keeps its own thick dark outline; crisp hard pixel edges without anti-aliasing; isolated on a flat solid {BG} background; the shield is centred and fills most of the frame.

variants.note: **纯色抽象纹章 · 不要盾形**（只用徽记符号，方形构图）
variants.prefix: Flat abstract heraldic emblem of a medieval noble house, a single bold symbol drawn with solid flat colour fills, four or five tinctures at most, no shading, no highlights, no gradients, no dithering, no bevel, no texture, thick uniform dark outline, geometric and minimal so it reads at tiny size, one-pixel pixel-art edges,
variants.suffix: No text, no letters, no banner, no ground shadow, no glow, no vignette, no gradients, no background texture, no watermark, no second object; crisp hard pixel edges without anti-aliasing; isolated on a flat solid {BG} background; the emblem is centred and fills most of the frame.

variants.note: **家族纹章设计稿**（2026-10-21 用户给的参考图那套）：盾 + 王冠 + 月桂 + 绶带 + 一个主纹，**单色墨稿**
variants.prefix: Heraldic coat of arms drawn as a single flat dark ink silhouette, engraved medieval family crest, ornate but clean: a heater shield with a crown on top, laurel branches flanking it, a ribbon banner below, one bold charge inside the shield, only one ink colour plus paper white, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no hatching, crisp clean vector edges, high contrast,
variants.suffix: No text, no letters, no motto, no words on the ribbon, no colour, no ground shadow, no glow, no vignette, no gradients, no paper texture, no watermark, no second emblem; crisp clean edges; isolated on a flat pure {BG} background; the coat of arms is centred and fills most of the frame.

variants.note: **只用主纹**（2026-10-21 用户：也不要皇冠绶带盾牌）：一个实心剪影符号占满画面，颜色后期上
variants.prefix: Flat heraldic emblem of a medieval noble house, one single bold symbol filling the frame and nothing else, drawn as a solid filled silhouette, one flat colour with a thin darker outline, high contrast, crisp clean vector edges, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no hatching,
variants.suffix: No text, no letters, no ribbon, no banner, no crown, no shield, no wreath, no laurel garland, no circular garland, no ornament, no border, no frame, no hollow outlines, no ground shadow, no glow, no vignette, no gradients, no paper texture, no watermark, no second object; crisp clean edges; isolated on a flat pure {BG} background; the emblem is centred and fills most of the frame.

variants.note: **单个剪影符号**（v7 仍会被加上月桂枝，改用「不要纹章」的说法）：平涂实心、只有一个主体
variants.prefix: Bold flat vector silhouette of a single subject, one solid colour, centred on a plain empty background, no decoration around it, clean smooth edges, high contrast,
variants.suffix: No text, no letters, no wreath, no branches, no laurel, no ornament, no shield, no crown, no ribbon, no banner, no frame, no border, no outline stroke, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no ground shadow, no glow, no watermark, no second object; isolated on a flat pure {BG} background; the single subject is centred and fills most of the frame.

style.suffix: No text, no frame, no border, no ground shadow, no glow, no vignette, no gradients, no second object, no background texture, no watermark; crisp hard pixel edges without anti-aliasing; isolated on a flat solid {BG} background; the single object is centred and fills most of the frame.
